offline_metric_contract.official_contact: Phase7 active-sole signed distance <= official reset clearance + one sole-sphere radius
offline_metric_contract.contact_timing: p95 nearest same-foot target transition error for each source-intended transition
offline_metric_contract.stance_speed: official ankle-roll body XY speed during model-estimated contact
offline_metric_contract.stance_excursion: maximum XY distance from the first frame of each contiguous model-estimated stance window
offline_metric_contract.severe_self_collision: official collision pair between two non-world bodies with penetration deeper than 0.030 m
offline_metric_contract.truth_boundary: all contact/collision/FK values are model estimates, not measured GRF/COP/force
